value.description: The MoMo Widget is a solution that enables a developer or partner to integrate a MoMoPay checkout button to accept Mobile Money payments on your e-commerce site.
value.terms:
Prerequires | Collection Widget
APIs | MoMoPay
Documentation | /widget-api

value.name: Collections | Enable remote collection of bills, fees or taxes.
value.description:
The MoMo Collection API product subscription allows businesses to receive payments directly from their customers' MoMo wallets into their business wallets. This streamlined payment process enables businesses to manage their finances more efficiently. 

By subscribing, partners can integrate a range of features into their e-commerce platforms, including QR code payments, refunds, debit status tracking, and detailed Know Your Customer (KYC) information. With these APIs, partners can automate debits, obtain customer consent, and access valuable customer insights to enhance their business operations.
value.terms:
Prerequires | OAuth 2.0
APIs | ValidateAccountHolder, Balance, RequestToPay
Documentation | /docs/services/collection

value.name: Disbursements | Automatically deposit funds to multiple users
value.description:
The MoMo Disbursement API product subscription offers a range of features for businesses. Key features include bulk payouts, business-to-business payments, and customer payouts, such as salaries. This streamlined payment process enables businesses to manage payments efficiently. 

By subscribing, partner can integrate features like QR code payments, refunds, and fund transfers with status updates into their e-commerce platforms. Additionally, they can access detailed Know Your Customer (KYC) information and integrate assisted products like cash-in APIs, and ERPs enhancing their overall payment experience.
value.terms:
Prerequires | OAuth 2.0
APIs | ValidateAccountHolder, Balance, Transfer
Documentation | /docs/services/disbursement
